text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I didn't even manage to place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So this is it... This is the extent of my
skills right
now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Let's climb all the way to the top...
Are you going to stop in a place l...
Are you going to stop in a place l...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's clear I'm not good enough right now.
Just
knowing that is a gain.
choice_data_list: Let's climb all the way to the top...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: In that case, I just have to run more until I am good enough. It's as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The next race is already near. Let's go
back so I
can get to training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I seem to have helped Admire Vega
improve her
mood!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That isn't an option to me—not since
that day I
decided to carry out this duty.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I'm too slow now, I'll need to keep on
running
to get faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's eyes are calm, but an
intense spirit
shines through. It seems my
words reached her!
